### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A14, A16, A17 and A18 disappear: before they appeared in about 21%, 26%, 25% and 29% of traces respectively; after, none of the 200 traces contains them. [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, POS001, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- In the later window, activities A15, A23, A24 and A25 appear in all 200 traces, whereas before they were absent from all traces. [OCC002, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, DIR002, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS002, POS006, POS007, POS008]
- Before, each of A14, A16, A17 and A18 was followed by A26; after, each of A15, A23, A24 and A25 is followed by A26. [DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR002, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008]
- A41 and A26 remain present in all traces, but the gap between them grows: before, A41 was 2 positions before A26 in all traces; after, it is 5 positions before A26. [LAG001, POS009, POS010]
- A26 shifts later in the trace (mean relative position from about 0.39 to 0.45), while A41 shifts slightly earlier (from about 0.33 to 0.29). [POS009, POS010]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the process changed from having a single middle activity chosen from A14, A16, A17 or A18 between A41 and A26, to having all four activities A15, A23, A24 and A25 between A41 and A26. In the later window, every trace contains A15, A23, A24 and A25, all after A41 and before A26, while the earlier middle activities are absent; the lag between A41 and A26 increases from 2 to 5 positions, consistent with a longer middle segment. The change is consistent across occurrence, direction, position and lag indicators. A competing explanation that the two windows simply sample different process variants cannot be fully excluded, but the complete disappearance of one set of activities and the universal appearance of the other in 200-trace windows makes sampling variation an unlikely sole explanation.

Need describe main behavioural differences. Evidence shows before window: activities A14, A16, A17, A18 occur in about 20-29% of traces, each followed by A26 (DIR before A14->A26 etc), and A26 occurs in all traces, A41 occurs in all traces. After window: A14, A16, A17, A18 absent (0 participation), instead A15, A23, A24, A25 occur in all traces, and A26 still all traces, A41 all traces. Also A15 etc appear after? Need understand structure.

Before: A14, A16, A17, A18 each in ~20-29% traces, each followed by A26. A26 in all traces, A41 in all traces. A41 before? REL A14-A41: before cooccurrence 0.205, B_before_A 0.205 (A41 before A14? Actually pair A14,A41: A_before_B = A14 before A41? components: A_before_B 0, B_before_A 0.205, so A41 before A14 in those cases). A26 before? REL A14-A26: before A_before_B 0.205 (A14 before A26). So before: A41 -> A14 -> A26? But A41 in all traces, A14 in 20.5%, A26 all. Also A16 etc before A26. A41 before A16 etc? REL A16-A41: B_before_A 0.255 (A41 before A16). So before pattern: A41 occurs early, then one of A14/A16/A17/A18, then A26. A26 after? A26 position mean 0.392 before, A41 mean 0.326 before, so A41 before A26. After: A15, A23, A24, A25 all in all traces, and A26 all, A41 all. REL A15-A26: after A_before_B 1.0 (A15 before A26). A15-A41: after B_before_A 1.0 (A41 before A15). So after: A41 -> A15 -> A26? But also A23, A24, A25 all before A26? REL A23-A26 after A_before_B 1.0, A24-A26 1.0, A25-A26 1.0. And A41 before A23/A24/A25? REL A23-A41 after B_before_A 1.0, etc. So after: A41 early, then A15/A23/A24/A25? But all four occur in all traces, and they are interleaved? REL among A15,A23,A24,A25: after cooccurrence 1.0, A_before_B and B_before_A roughly half each, so they appear in varying order, all before A26. So after window: A41 -> (A15, A23, A24, A25 in some order) -> A26. Before: A41 -> one of A14/A16/A17/A18 -> A26. So the set of "middle" activities changed from four alternatives (each in ~20-30% of traces) to four activities all present in every trace. Also A26 position shifted later (mean 0.392 to 0.449), A41 position earlier (0.326 to 0.294). LAG A41-A26: before lag 2 (A41 then A26 two positions apart? Actually lag 2 = 1.0), after lag 5 = 1.0. So distance between A41 and A26 increased from 2 to 5 positions, consistent with more middle activities.

Need formulate hypothesis: In later window, the process appears to have replaced a single optional middle activity (one of A14/A16/A17/A18) with a sequence of four activities A15/A23/A24/A25 that all occur, increasing trace length and shifting A26 later. But need be careful: "structural change" hypothesis. Evidence supports that the set of activities between A41 and A26 changed: before one of four alternatives, after four activities all present. This is direct and consistent across OCC, DIR, REL, POS, LAG. Need mention limitations: Could be sampling? But all 200 traces after have A15 etc, before none; before 41-58 traces have A14 etc, after none. Strong. However, need consider that A15 before absent, A23 etc absent before. So yes.

Need decide support level: Supported hypothesis. Need state as possibility supported, not confirmed. Need name activities. Need mention competing explanation: e.g., variant frequency differences? But given all traces after have new activities and none old, sampling unlikely. But maybe the process changed to a different variant? Actually structural change. Need mention limitation: cannot rule out that the observed windows come from different process variants or that activity labels changed? But no speculation. Need mention "the evidence cannot rule out that the before and after windows represent different process variants rather than a single process change" maybe. But support level supported.
